question: What all-pervading range must be contemplated in each place during this meditation?
premises: Meditation is to be done in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Shiva down to Avici.
This range defines the scope of contemplation.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality extending from Shiva down to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated in place after place on that which extends from Shiva down to Avici.
